statements.label: Lemma 1
statements.restatement: On the rational chart b=1+A, p=b+P, r=V/(1+V), a=r^2/b, s=S/(1+S), e=b(b+1)U/(1+U), c=s^2(1/e+1/(b+1)), j=J* T/(1+T), J*=(b+1)(1-s)^2/(b+2s+(b+1)s^2/e), with A,T,U,V,S>0, P>=0, d=1: if Phi>=0 then G is strictly increasing in q>=0. Purely algebraic (no realizability claim, no claim about G(0)).
